title: SilicaGuard patient-facing content file
description: Message definitions for everything a worker reads or hears. Master Reference v1.0 8.4: every patient-facing string is human-authored, clinically reviewed, versioned, and stored against a message code with one row per language. No runtime machine translation. Instrument question and option wording lives here too, referenced by label_message_code from clinical/.

area.description: Grouping label for the file, e.g. results, consent, education, instrument. Documentation only.

code.description: Stable key. Referenced by clinical/ instrument files, by the services that send messages, and by consent records. Never changed once an approved version uses it.

channel.description: Determines the character budget. sms is one GSM-7 segment; ussd must fit a page including options and navigation; app and clinician are readability ceilings.

status.description: approved is immutable: a change is a new version, because a consent text or result message must be reproducible for any session that referenced it.

approved_by.description: The Clinical Lead's name. Required when status is approved.

purpose.description: What this message is for and when it is sent. Read by whoever reviews or translates it.

placeholders.description: Named substitutions the sender must supply, written {like_this} in every language. Declared so the validator can check that every language uses exactly the same set -- a placeholder present in English and missing in Shona sends a broken message to the people least able to query it.

max_len_override.description: Raise or lower the channel budget for this message only, with a reason in notes. Use sparingly: the budgets exist because of transport limits and cost, not style.

comprehension_tested.description: 8.4's quality method: the message was read aloud to miners who were asked to say back what it means. Records whether that happened, not merely that it was translated.

text.description: One entry per language. English, Shona and Ndebele are all required before a message may be approved; Ndebele is not optional in this geography (8.4).
